verdict.rationale: Clerk documents an official remote MCP server that AI agents such as Claude, Cursor and GitHub Copilot can connect to. It exposes SDK snippets plus account tools for creating apps, managing users and setting up production instances, and the CLI can wire it into AI clients in one command. Connect-client docs cover CIMD and Dynamic Client Registration, and a probe confirms the MCP doc page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually connecting and using the server.
